summary: Iteration 15: tested the 'pagado' default and the CartoCiudad address register. BACKEND: the new test_iter15_payment_cartociudad.py passes 21 of 21. Owner POST /api/orders with amount 0 forces 'pagado' even when 'efectivo' is sent, and a GET confirms it. With an amount, efectivo, datafono and pagado are kept as sent, and the default is efectivo. Business POST /api/biz/orders behaves the same, tested with a temporary business account that was created and deleted. Autocomplete: all 5 of the main agent's cases come first, with exact=true and lat/lng in Madrid. Higher numbers come first and exact: Alcalá 350 (28017), Castellana 200 (28046), Bravo Murillo 300, Toledo 120 and Arturo Soria 250. Postcode filter 'Calle Mayor 5 28012' works, accents and abbreviations ('Calle de Alcalá 50', 'C/ Alcala 50', 'Av. de America 10') work, and so does the near parameter. Server-side geocode with no dest coordinates gives 40.41938,-3.69158. Each call takes about 1.2 to 2 s. REGRESSION: the iter11 to iter15 suites pass 71 of 71, after updating 5 stale assertions: accent-free CartoCiudad labels, street rows without coordinates, and the iter13 rule that business photos are visible across businesses. FRONTEND at 375x667: as owner, an empty amount shows only the 'Ya pagado' chip, selected, with payment-auto-hint. Typing 12,50 shows all 3 chips with Efectivo selected, and clearing the amount goes back to pagado. As a business, the behaviour is the same. 'Calle de Alcala 50' shows 8 suggestions, and the first is 'Calle Alcala 50, Madrid (28014)'. Picking it shows customer-address-verified, and the created order stores dest 40.41938,-3.69158 with payment 'pagado' (checked in the DB). As a business, 'gran via 28' gives 'Calle Gran Via 28, Madrid (28013)', verified, and the order is saved with coordinates and 'pagado'. BUG FOUND: the payment choice is lost after the amount is cleared and retyped (see action_items). No deprecated Expo packages detected. All test data was cleaned up and no account is locked.

minor.issue: CartoCiudad labels lose accents and particles: 'Calle Alcala', 'Calle Gran Via', 'Paseo Castellana 200', 'Calle Pez' (should be 'Calle del Pez'), 'Avenida America'. Cause: CartoCiudad returns upper-case text with no accents, and server.py:186 applies .title(). Cosmetic only, but labels in the Spanish UI look misspelled.
Apostrophes come out as a double quote: 'Calle O"Donnell 10, Madrid (28009)'. The raw CartoCiudad data uses '"', so add .replace('"', "'") in cartociudad_rows (server.py:182-186).

When CartoCiudad returns fewer than 3 rows with coordinates (for example Castellana 200, Toledo 120, Alcalá 350), Photon and Nominatim rows are added in a different label format. This gives near-duplicates such as 'Paseo Castellana 200, Madrid (28046)' and 'Paseo de la Castellana 200, 28046 Madrid', POI rows ('Monster Sushi, Paseo...'), and results outside Madrid ('Calle San Diego de Alcalá, 35001 Las Palmas' for 'Calle de Alcala 350').

Street-only CartoCiudad rows (type 'callejero') have lat/lng null. Examples are the first result for 'Calle Mayor 28013' and every result for 'Calle de Serrano'. In the UI, tapping one only fills the text and nothing is picked. iter14 showed a selectable 'Calle Mayor, 28013 Madrid' first, which now comes third. A POI row on another street, 'LOCK & enjoy ... Calle de la Escalinata 1', is marked exact=true for 'Calle Mayor 28013', because exact only checks the number.
Returns 500 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' repeatedly in backend.out.log. This existed before this iteration and is an environment or configuration issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Steps: type an amount, pick Datáfono, clear the amount (it goes to 'Ya pagado', which is correct), then type an amount again. 'Ya pagado' stays selected; it does not go back to Datáfono or Efectivo. An order with an amount to collect can then be saved as already paid, so the courier will not collect. Root cause: the useEffect at new.tsx:73-76 overwrites payment with 'pagado', and because paymentTouched.current is still true it never resets. The same happens if the user taps the already-selected 'Ya pagado' chip while the amount is empty: paymentTouched becomes true, and typing an amount keeps 'Ya pagado'.

issues: The payment chips are 36px tall, below the 44px minimum touch target (Chip in ui.tsx).
Chip's accessibilityState selected is not exposed as aria-selected on web, so the selected state is visible only through the background colour.

action_items: HIGH new.tsx:56-76,184: keep the user's pick in its own state (userPick) and derive payment = subtotal <= 0 ? 'pagado' : (userPick ?? 'efectivo'). Do not mark the choice as touched when the amount is empty. Retest: amount, pick Datáfono, clear, retype should give Datáfono again.

server.py:186: keep the CartoCiudad label but fix the apostrophe (replace '"' with "'"). Optionally restore accents and particles, for example by preferring the Photon/Nominatim label when the same portal matches.
osm_suggest: when CartoCiudad has the exact portal, drop the Photon/Nominatim near-duplicates of the same street and number. Filter out fallback rows outside Madrid when Madrid rows exist.
callejero rows with no coordinates: geocode the street centroid, or send them to the bottom so a selectable row comes first.
Optional: make the payment chips at least 44px tall.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1820 lines; split geocoding and suggestions (lines 94-400) into their own module.
build_order: with items whose prices total 0, payment is also forced to 'pagado'. This is consistent with the rule.
cartociudad_rows makes 2 sequential CartoCiudad calls (municipio, then provincia) per query that is not cached. Latency is about 1.2 to 2 s; consider running them in parallel.

For a business UI login, use tests/temp_biz_account.py create/delete.
rca_of_issue: Payment choice lost: new.tsx useEffect([subtotal]) calls setPayment('pagado') when subtotal <= 0, which wipes the user's earlier choice. When the amount is typed again, the else branch is skipped because paymentTouched.current is true, so 'pagado' remains. Fix by deriving the shown payment from the amount and a separately stored userPick.
